parts.gloss: he who does not show love

words.gloss: him who does not show love

literal: By waking state him who does not show love, by dream because of seeing, exists my life.
translation: Because I behold him in my dreams who does not show me love in my waking hours, my life still survives.
modern: விழித்திருக்கும்போது எனக்கு அன்பு செய்யாதவரை, கனவில் காண்பதனால் தான் என் உயிர் இன்னும் நிலைத்திருக்கிறது.
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the separation of her lover, explains how she manages to stay alive. While awake, her lover does not come to show her affection or comfort her. However, she is able to see him and experience his love in her dreams. It is this dream-encounter that sustains her spirit and keeps her alive despite the painful reality of her waking hours.
